name: Second Elixir Book: Production-Grade REST API with Phoenix

mentions.name: Second Elixir Book: Production-Grade REST API with Phoenix
mentions.description: A self-published technical book on building a production-grade REST API with Elixir and Phoenix. Unlike typical books that document only the happy path for small, simplistic apps, it covers the business context, the questions and decisions behind them, the decision-making process, and the gotchas and side-quests encountered along the way, aiming to bridge the gap from tutorials to real software engineering. It is the author's second Elixir book, following a successful book on learning Ecto.
mentions.problem: Many technical books document only the "happy path" for small, simplistic applications without boundary conditions or business thinking, leaving readers stuck in tutorial hell without guidance on real software engineering.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my second self-published technical book related to Elixir. The first one has been a surprising success, but since it was about learning to use Ecto on the basis of an old pedagogical toy database (and tiny dataset), the new book is about the development of a production-grade REST API with Elixir and Phoenix.
